catalog.title: Supplier products

catalog.targetHelp: This selection applies to import; the catalog is shared.

catalog.sourceDownloaded: File downloaded to Hub: {{date}} · {{size}} MB. Products were not processed by this action.

catalog.fullShopCheck: Full shop check on next preview

catalog.localListingHint: Hub records only so far; the shop has not been checked yet. Preview will verify it.
catalog.noResultsHelp: Try a shorter name or remove a filter. Empty search shows the entire feed.
catalog.startDownloadHelp: Click Download feed. You can then browse all products or search.
catalog.importRunning: Import is running on the server. You can close this screen.
catalog.importScope: Only selected items are imported. Existing products are skipped. Stock quantities are not sent.
catalog.createValidationField: On confirmation, this shop will receive a validation_required custom checkbox shared across languages.
catalog.uncertainHelp: An uncertain request is not automatically resent. Rechecking reads the shop; unresolved items need review before a new import.
catalog.retryImport: Recheck result and retry unsent items
catalog.editPricesHelp: Enter selling prices including VAT. Changes apply only to this import and selected shop.
catalog.pricesNeedPreview: Prices have changed. Recalculate and verify the preview before importing.

codes.duplicate_supplier_code: The supplier uses this code in multiple records. No EAN or price is chosen automatically; importing this code is blocked.

codes.sale_below_purchase: A selling price is lower than its purchase price. Review the prices; they are not changed automatically.
codes.manual_sale_price: The selling price was manually changed for this import.
codes.invalid_sale_price: Enter a positive selling price with at most two decimal places.
codes.price_override_not_selected: A changed price is outside the current selection. Prepare a new preview.
codes.missing_price: No valid selling price for the target shop's VAT mode.
codes.currency_mismatch: Feed and target currencies differ. Currency conversion is not enabled.

codes.variant_attributes_ambiguous: Variants do not have unique parameter combinations.

codes.primary_ean_exported: Upgates receives the first EAN; all EANs remain in Hub.

codes.selection_identity_conflict: Selection contains conflicting codes or EANs. Select the correct item.

codes.local_mapping_conflict: Hub product is linked to a different shop code.

codes.request_failed: Request failed. Check the connection and try again.
codes.shop_not_ready: Configure the shop's Upgates connection first.

codes.shop_vat_unknown: Could not verify the shop's price VAT mode.

codes.shop_target_changed: Shop connection changed. Create a new preview.
codes.preview_expired: Preview expired. Prepare a new preview.
codes.import_not_started: Import has not been confirmed yet.

codes.shop_options_changed: Shop settings changed. Prepare a new preview.
codes.validation_field_create_failed: Could not confirm creation of validation_required. No products were sent.
codes.import_outcome_unknown: The send outcome is unconfirmed. Verify in the shop before another import.
codes.import_readback_mismatch: The shop did not confirm hidden visibility, the review flag or all selected variants.
codes.import_verified_by_readback: Outcome confirmed by reading the shop after sending.
codes.unsafe_import_payload: Import data does not meet the hidden-product and no-stock rules.
codes.catalog_parser_unavailable: This supplier feed parser is not available yet.
codes.feed_file_missing: Configured local feed file does not exist.
codes.feed_url_missing: Feed URL is missing from configuration.

codes.feed_download_failed: Could not download the feed. Check configuration and supplier availability.
codes.feed_tls_failed: The supplier TLS certificate could not be verified. Check the certificate and feed address.

codes.shop_check_running: Another check of this shop is running. Try again shortly.
codes.feed_connection_failed: The supplier connection failed or was interrupted during download.

codes.feed_not_found: The supplier could not find a feed at the configured address (HTTP 404).

codes.catalog_source_conflict: This supplier code belongs to another feed. Resolve the source conflict first.
codes.catalog_parse_failed: Could not process the feed. The last successful catalog is preserved.
codes.shop_required: Choose a shop for this filter.
codes.catalog_items_missing: Some selected products are no longer in the feed. Reload your selection.
codes.catalog_product_missing: Product was not found in the catalog.
codes.invalid_price_vat: Gross and net prices do not match the configured VAT rate. Check supplier VAT settings.
codes.some_variants_in_shop: Some selected variants already exist in the shop. Remove them from the selection and verify a new preview for the remaining variants.

catalog.existingPriceUnchanged: Already in shop · this import does not change its price
